interface Self<T extends T> extends T {}
interface Mutual<T extends U, U extends T> extends T {}
interface Intersected<T extends T & { a: 1 }> extends T {}
interface Indexed<T extends T[keyof T]> extends T {}
interface Conditional<T extends (T extends string ? T : never)> extends T {}
interface Valid<T extends { a: number }> {
  value: T;
}
const valid: Valid<{ a: number }> = { value: { a: 1 } };
console.log(valid.value.a);
